notes: Not a pure marker interface despite the class name - instances of this class are used as identity/generation tokens: HintIconState.aSingletonMarker_2372 and WidgetComponent.aSingletonMarker_838 each hold a 'current' SingletonMarker instance that is replaced (a fresh SingletonMarker()) whenever the underlying hint-icon/widget state changes; NativeRenderer/D3dRenderDevice/GlRenderDevice each cache a copy of one of these tokens (aSingletonMarker_8184) and use `!=` identity comparisons to detect staleness and trigger a rebuild (method3929/method3913). This method checks whether `this` token still matches one of the two current global tokens (`this == HintIconState.aSingletonMarker_2372 || WidgetComponent.aSingletonMarker_838 == this`). Notably the leading `if (i >= -1) return true` fast path is a dead opaque predicate at every real call site: all observed callers (NativeRenderer.kt, D3dRenderDevice.kt, GlRenderDevice.kt) pass sentinels of -32, -45, -48, -90, -94, -98, -112, -116 - all < -1 - so the identity-comparison branch is actually the one that always executes, the reverse of the usual 'dead branch' pattern in this codebase.

Override of Any.toString() that unconditionally throws IllegalStateException() (after incrementing a counter) - deliberately unimplemented/forbidden, likely to catch accidental toString() calls on what is meant to be a pure identity token with no printable representation. Cannot be usefully renamed since it overrides a platform method; kept as toString for documentation purposes only.
